connector.name: OntoRamp Knowledge Cartographer
connector.registryDescription: Knowledge coverage map and health score. Ingest docs into a governed knowledge graph via MCP.
connector.summary: Hosted at ontoramp-knowledge-cartographer.fly.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.ontoramp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key. Get your free key at ontoramp.com/mcp
